# quismon_status_page (Resource)

The organization's public status page (one per organization). Checks appear on the page when their show_on_status_page flag is set, or all of them when show_all_checks is true.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `show_all_checks` (Boolean) Show every enabled check instead of only visible_check_ids
- `show_incident_history` (Boolean) Show incident history on the page
- `show_response_times` (Boolean) Show response time charts on the page
- `show_uptime_percentage` (Boolean) Show uptime percentages on the page
- `slug` (String) URL slug (immutable after creation; page lives at /status/<slug>)
- `title` (String) Page title

### Optional

- `access_mode` (String) Access protection: public, token, domain, or password. Free tier is always public.
- `access_password` (String, Sensitive) Access password for password mode (write-only, not returned by the API)
- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Access token for token mode (write-only, not returned by the API)
- `allowed_domains` (List of String) Allowed email domains for domain mode
- `description` (String) Optional page description
- `incident_history_days` (Number) How many days of incident history to show (default 30)
- `logo_url` (String) Optional logo image URL
- `primary_color` (String) Primary accent color as hex (e.g. #8b5cf6)
- `theme` (String) Color theme: light or dark (default dark)
- `visible_check_ids` (List of String) Check IDs shown when show_all_checks is false

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Status page ID (UUID)
- `url` (String) Public URL of the status page
